LOOP ITERATION 16 — LIVE VERIFICATION OF THIS STORY, triggered now that its code is on main.

J10 merged (db2b0dc14) and closed on UNIT evidence: 1660 reconciler tests, 11 held-out contract tests,
lint/typecheck clean. But the operator's standing rule is that live testing is the oracle for ALL
functionality, and unit-tier green is exactly what this epic has repeatedly been while broken in
reality. So J10's live effect was UNVERIFIED at close.

That matters specifically here because the translation went in at _with_connection_retry — the single
choke point EVERY DC transport method routes through. A regression there would affect all twelve
existing live-tested behaviours, and no unit test exercises the real retry path against a real server.

Triggered GitHub Actions run 30623000498 on main (workflow external-integration.yml, job
'jira DC harness smoke'). What I expect, stated in advance so the result can falsify it:
 * the 12 previously-passing harness tests should STILL pass — that is the regression check, and the
   real reason for this run;
 * test_reconcile_pass.py's writing tests should STILL FAIL, because set_entity_property is still
   absent (J9 implements it; J10 only translated exceptions, and a missing attribute raises
   AttributeError, not JIRAError, so translation cannot mask it);
 * the PAT-cap error [rebar:f391-806b-938f-45d8] may recur — the harness mints a fresh PAT per test
   and Jira DC caps a user at 10.

If the 12 regress, J10 broke something the unit tier cannot see and this ticket reopens. If they hold
and the writing tests still fail on set_entity_property, that is clean evidence J10 did its job and
the remaining gap is exactly J9's.

Not blocking anything on this run: it parallelizes safely against the plan-review gate because CI is
external, not store-lock or LLM bound.
